<section id="source-model">
<h1>Source model</h1>
<section id="canonical-source">
<h2>Canonical source</h2>
<p>The source of truth is the fragment tree under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger_dir</span></code>:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sections/</span></code> for the major arc42 chapter skeleton</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">records/</span></code> for individual architecture facts</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archive/</span></code> for archived records and tombstones that preserve allocated ledger IDs</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Records include structural, behavioral, and decision artifacts plus first-class
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagram</span></code> records. Diagram records default to plain text diagrams (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagram_type</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;text&quot;</span></code>).
Text diagrams stay embedded in Markdown/AsciiDoc record bodies as readable fenced blocks.
Mermaid is available for compact sequence, state, or flow diagrams but is not the default.</p>
<p>Fragments contain YAML front matter and a body in the configured dialect.
Archived fragments keep normal front matter and use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status:</span> <span class="pre">archived</span></code>.
Archledger does not store creation, update, or archive timestamps in ledger
source. Every current source fragment has a positive monotonic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code>.
CLI mutation commands increment it exactly once; manual source edits must
increment it manually.</p>
</section>
<section id="ledger-id-format">
<h2>Ledger ID format</h2>
<p>Default IDs use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;prefix&gt;_&lt;number&gt;</span></code> (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0013</span></code>).</p>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[ids].segment_mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;type&quot;</span></code>, IDs use
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;prefix&gt;_&lt;segment&gt;_&lt;number&gt;</span></code> (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_content_0013</span></code> and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_risk_0014</span></code>). Segment values come from metadata/config mapping, while
the numeric sequence remains one global ledger-wide counter.</p>
</section>
<section id="traceability">
<h2>Traceability</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_refs</span></code> when fragments describe real files or directories.
Directory refs must end with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">/</span></code> and must exist in the workspace.</p>
</section>
<section id="generated-output">
<h2>Generated output</h2>
<p>Generated build outputs are derived artifacts and should not be edited as
source. New projects default to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build/</span></code> under the workspace root, and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[build].default_output_dir</span></code> may place outputs elsewhere.</p>
</section>
<section id="external-references">
<h2>External references</h2>
<p>Use generic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">links</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_refs</span></code> for artifacts outside the architecture
ledger. Archledger preserves these references as data and does not interpret
external domain semantics.</p>
<p>Example:</p>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nt">links</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nt">rel</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">documents</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">target_kind</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">path</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">target</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">specs/behavior/features/task-management/plan-gates.feature</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">reason</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">External artifact documents the runtime flow.</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
